title: Day Two at the Portrait Conference
content: I sketchedJeffrey Heinfrom the side of the main stage as he painted a two hour demo yesterday morning at the Portrait Society conference here in Washington, DC.The day was filled with lots of demos and programs. In the afternoon, I gave a presentation about practical tips for location sketching using all sorts of media from colored pencils to watercolor, gouache, casein, and oil.Day 1 at the 2014 PSoA conferencePortrait Society of America
